answer: Require each newcomer to serve an apprenticeship across three disconnected trust clusters before it can earn. Like a bridge over tundra that holds only when anchored on separate shores, it posts a bond, then completes verifiable jobs for unrelated veterans in each cluster, spaced across days despite any gale of fake signups. Sponsors co-stake their own rewards on the apprentice and lose them if that newcomer proves a duplicate. A Sybil farm must thus fund many bonds, buy distinct work histories and risk sponsor losses everywhere, so fake identities cost more than honest work pays.
